title: AyushNetra v2.0
summary: AyushNetra is an AI-enabled early warning, treatment, and lifestyle recommendation system built on India's AYUSH Hospital Management Information System, combining voice-based EHR, outbreak forecasting, and reinforcement-learning treatment recommendations. Its requirements.txt lists sdv==1.11.0 annotated as CTGAN for a planned synthetic-data module, but no code in the evidence actually invokes it.
evidence: requirements.txt: "sdv==1.11.0  # CTGAN"; data/synthetic/ directory described as "CTGAN data generation" with no matching code hits
needs: No source code call sites for sdv were found; the data/synthetic module referenced in the README could not be verified as actually invoking SDV/CTGAN.
